summary: A reader-owned Figma file for the existing Velori exercise.

expectedEntries.text: Replaced the owner-file access prerequisite with a downloadable Velori Figma companion imported into the reader's own Drafts. Navigation uses verified page and frame names; each import records native identities and checks local dependencies and the prototype journey.
expectedEntries.rationale: Readers can complete the existing Figma exercise without access to the author's file.
